name: value-proposition
text: RESEARCH QUESTION  |  How can we transfer a human movement to the Unitree G1 without losing what the action means—and still make it safe and stable for the robot? We also study how PPO training choices change the result in MuJoCo / MJLab.

name: story-question
text: WHY IT MATTERS  |  A motion can look right in a video but still make the robot slip, collide or fall. We therefore evaluate both how closely the robot copies the action and whether it can complete it safely.

name: conclusions
text: The value is the complete bridge: preserve human intent in the reference, then learn whether the robot can execute it. Better references, balanced rewards and task-matched initialisation all improve this bridge.
